notice: Every indicator below is synthetic. Addresses come from ranges IANA reserves for documentation (RFC 5737) and domains use the RFC 2606 reserved .invalid/.example suffixes. None of these values identify real infrastructure, and none of them came from a threat intelligence feed. SENTINEL-X ships no external feed integration by default; see docs/architecture.md for where a real provider would attach.
